statement: Power transformer lead times average 128 weeks (up to 200 weeks for specialty semiconductor-fab units), with transformer prices up 77% since 2019.
why: Extreme transformer lead times and price inflation are a hard upstream constraint on data-center power build-out.

impact.mechanism: Long-lead electrical gear delays AI data-center energisation, constraining deployable supply.

evidence.excerpt: power transformers average lead times ran 128 weeks for large units, specialty semiconductor fab units stretched to 200 weeks

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 50.0 -> 128.0 (tol 1%); sources: Supply Chain Connect
